newsitem.title: UK: HSBC details senior executive jobs.
newsitem.headline: HSBC details senior executive jobs.

text.p: International banking group HSBC Holdings Plc on Wednesday announced three senior executive appointments including a head for its newly-expanded Brazilian operation.
This will be run by Michael Geoghegan who has been appointed group general manager and chief executive officer, Brazil.
Geoghegan will also continue to integrate Banco HSBC Bamerindus, recently bought by HSBC, of which he is chief executive.
Other appointments announced included Malcolm Burnett who has been made group general manager in conjunction with his role as chief banking officer of HSBC's U.S. banking unit, Marine Midland Bank.
Bert McPhee, currently head of credit and risk at HSBC's UK banking unit Midland Bank, will take on group responsibility for credit and risk as group general manager.
